description: Define per-component input properties (Node / Segment / Space / Graph). Wire the output into a Graph or Space node to attach them — they surface in each component's Properties tab. The left params input can take a node's params (e.g. Display Node) to derive a schema from its fields.
instructions:
A general component-property schema, edited inline on the node via four foldable sections — Node / Segment / Space / Graph — each a list of parameters (label, type, unit, default, min/max/step, options, solver role) like the Input Properties node.

Wire its OUTPUT into a Graph node to attach the Node/Segment/Graph properties to that graph's components, or into a Space node to attach the Space properties — they then appear in each component's Properties tab (added to the built-ins, never replacing them). The `pin` params input can take a node's params output (e.g. Display Node) to derive the schema from that node's fields.

NOTE: the four sections are edited by the on-node schema editor; `name` is an optional label.
